content.what_it_is: A 3,299-line Fortran source containing the full internal-wavemaker pipeline. WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION dispatches regular, measured 2-D, time-series, legacy irregular/TMA/JONSWAP, absorbing-boundary, and 2021 coherent-wave modes, reads spectra, filters components, allocates shared arrays, constructs source coefficients, and precomputes cosine/sine spatial fields (L51-L613). WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA and the legacy irregular/regular/time-series generators solve an approximate dispersion relation and form Wei-Kirby Gaussian source strength, transverse wavenumber, beta, and width (L627-L819, L1835-L2472). CALCULATE_Cm_Sm, CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm, both CALCULATE_TMA variants, and CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm build spatial harmonic coefficient fields for elevation and velocity, including periodic-angle adjustment and parallel global-index offsets (L831-L1819, L3047-L3170). VISCOSITY_WMAKER caps breaker viscosity inside the wavemaker footprint (L2484-L2550); IRREGULAR_LEFT_BC reconstructs staged boundary eta/u/v and fluxes (L2560-L2623). The 2021 routines ingest or synthesize one-direction-per-frequency spectra, optionally coalesce frequencies to impose coherence, and group equal frequencies via loop_index (L2636-L3299).

unresolved: The periodic WK_REG initialization computes 2*pi/Tperiod before testing Tperiod==ZERO (L83-L91). The same ineffective ordering recurs in WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (Tperiod=1/Freq at L783, test at L788), WK_WAVEMAKER_REGULAR_WAVE (division L2381, test L2385), WK_WAVEMAKER_TIME_SERIES (division L2435, test L2441), and WK_NEW_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA (division L2760, test L2766); zero frequency/period can fault before the intended guard.

WK_DATA2D compresses retained directions and WAVE_COMP into DireTmp/WaveCompTmp (L238-L275) but never applies the same index map to Phase2D read at L213-L215. When phases are present, L295-L301 converts the first NumDir original phase columns, which need not correspond to the retained directions after rejected columns; amplitude and phase can therefore be paired from different directions.

Optional phase EOF jumps from L214 to label 110 at L230, bypassing CLOSE(1) at L217; the analogous jump from L463 to L478 bypasses CLOSE(1) at L465. The WK_TIME branch opens and reads unit 1 at L351-L355 but reaches its branch end at L365 without any CLOSE, leaving unit state dependent on later runtime behavior.

The non-CARTESIAN periodic-angle code indexes DY(I,J) using the angle-search counter I and a nonlocal/stale J at L691 and L707, while adjacent branches use DY(1,1) at L675 and L723. CalcPeriodicTheta repeats the same copy pattern at L1102 and L1119 versus DY(1,1) at L1087 and L1135, creating wrong-cell or out-of-range access unrelated to the caller's grid point.

WK_WAVEMAKER_2D_SPECTRAL_DATA returns Beta_gen(NumFreq,NumDir) (L638), and initialization passes Beta_gen2D to CALCULATE_Cm_Sm (L328-L332), but CALCULATE_Cm_Sm declares beta_gen(mfreq) (L842) and indexes only beta_gen(kf) in the direction loop (L858-L880). This is a rank/interface mismatch and discards direction-dependent beta values.

CALCULATE_TMA_Cm_Sm replaces a zero Freq(kff) with Freq(kff-1) at L1302-L1304, so kff=1 reads Freq(0); it also compares Freq(mfreq-1) at L1312 when mfreq may equal 1. WK_WAVEMAKER_IRREGULAR_WAVE duplicates both bounds hazards at L1921-L1929.
All equal-frequency variants divide by mfreq-1 without an mfreq>1 guard (L1584, L2160, L2849). A one-component configuration therefore produces a singular df before later loops.

WK_WAVEMAKER_IRREGULAR_WAVE recomputes the peak-frequency wkn at L2095-L2099 but assigns width from wave_length left by the final component iteration at L2100; it never recomputes wave_length from the peak wkn. The copy in WK_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE has the same stale dependence at L2337-L2342, and WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE repeats it at L3025-L3030.

WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE initializes only theta(1) and AG(1) when mtheta==1 (L2860-L2862), although both arrays have length mfreq (L2832-L2834). It later evaluates dot_product over all AG entries (L2914), reads AG(kf) for every component (L2917-L2919), and reads theta(kf) in the component loop (L2940, L3015-L3019), so entries 2:mfreq are used before assignment.

displace_theta is declared INTEGER,DIMENSION(mfreq) at L2843 but receives MINLOC of a rank-one array at L2864, whose result has extent one. Only displace_theta(1) is used at L2865; the nonconformable whole-array assignment can fail shape checking or overwrite inconsistently depending on compiler/runtime settings.

phi1 in WK_NEW_EQUAL_DFREQ_IRREGULAR_WAVE is INTENT(OUT) (L2836) but random phases are assigned only inside IF(PERIODIC) at L2941-L3014. The nonperiodic return leaves phi1 undefined, yet WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION immediately passes it to CALCULATE_NEW_Cm_Sm (L590-L599), whose trigonometric fields read phi1 at L3105-L3117 and L3128-L3162.

VISCOSITY_WMAKER lists Xc_WK and Yc_WK twice in one USE GLOBAL, ONLY list across L2486-L2487. This copy-paste duplicate is rejected by some Fortran compilers as a repeated use-associated name and has no semantic need.

The new measured-spectrum initialization sets T_brk=Freq(FreqCount) at L557-L559, whereas the other irregular branches set a period as 1/FreqMax at L409-L411 and L604-L606 and the legacy data/time paths take a time/period column at L335-L337 and L361-L363. The cross-branch units for T_brk are inconsistent.

WAVE_COHERENCE computes candidate_freq_idx=ceiling(rand()*mfreq_temp) (L3254-L3263); a random result of exactly zero yields index 0. The loop also has no exhaustion guard before shrinking candidate_freq_pool (L3264-L3273), while a 100% request is permitted at L2889 and sets Num_Coherent to mfreq at L3213; if the requested COUNT(repetitions>1) cannot be reached before the pool empties, the next iteration indexes an empty pool.

In parallel out-of-range handling, CalcPeriodicTheta calls MPI_FINALIZE at L1070 but has no STOP or RETURN before normal computation resumes at L1076-L1078; serial builds STOP at L1074. Whether MPI_FINALIZE returns makes the purported fatal range guard ineffective and permits post-finalization execution.

WK_NEW_DATA2D deliberately sets NumDir=2 at L448 while allocating all generated second dimensions as one at L450-L452 and L495-L499. The called new routines declare fixed second dimension one and mostly ignore mtheta/NumDir (L2646-L2655, L3061-L3065), so the metadata says two directions while storage and computation implement one; any downstream consumer that trusts NumDir can exceed these arrays.
